fusions.name: Taproot Snare
fusions.desc: Roots burst from beneath you into every enemy within 3 tiles, dealing 10 damage, stunning them for 1 second and stripping 10% armour and 25% movement speed for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Drawn Sap
fusions.desc: Costs 4% of your maximum health to deal 8 damage, leaving the target 8% easier to wound for 4 seconds. You heal for 25% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Barked Over
fusions.desc: You regain 3 health a second for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Heartwood Lining
fusions.desc: Your armour rises by 10%, and you regenerate 0.5 health a second.
